name: DEFINE-stage guidance, prompts and managed rules
purpose: serve the DEFINE-stage guidance pages, the argument-free MCP prompts and the managed-block rules that steer the harness through intake and the question loop.
responsibilities: guidance/define-intent.md: the PO-register loop content from spec section 1.1, 1.2 and 1.4 as operator prose; wording rules for the PO register; what to print at the end.

guidance/elicitation-playbook.md: the L-sized restructure named in spec section 6 (sections 2 to 8 around D1 to D8 over the delta, the PO loop as the first worked example and the CSV feature as the second).
guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md: the two rules of spec section 6 last row - the PO-session rule and the prototype rule. The managed block regeneration never removes an existing rule.
guidance/manifest.json: register the new slug `define-intent`, the `rcf://docs/define-intent` resource, and the two new argument-free prompts `rcf_define_intent` and `rcf_define_intake`.
serves `rcf_define_intent` and `rcf_define_intake` prompts and the two managed-block rules of REQ-186 and REQ-187.

serves `rcf_define_draft_shapes` and `rcf_discover_prototype` prompts and `guidance/discovery-prototypes.md` (REQ-188, REQ-182 amended): the draft-shapes prompt walks the agent through pre-populating `[draft]` core entities, TAC stubs and interfaces after L1; the discovery-prototype prompt walks the agent through recording a prototype in DISCOVERY as evidence; `guidance/discovery-prototypes.md` carries the doctrine and the ledger conventions and is also served as `rcf://docs/discovery-prototypes`; the managed block gains one prototype rule (ADR-4132) stating that a statement sourced to `prototype:` is evidence and a document citing prototype code as its implementation is a D2 finding the engineer resolves by re-deriving.

serves `rcf_define_litmus` prompt (0.30.0 PR 7, spec section 6 row): the argument-free markdown walks the harness through spawning n fresh-context readers and landing their readings as probe-ledger entries whose `finding` begins `litmus:<reader>:` and whose text includes the current `hash`. Registered through `guidance/manifest.json` and served through the existing MCP prompt plumbing. No new resource URI.
internalStructure: The MCP prompt and resource plumbing (src/mcp/prompts.js, src/mcp/resources.js) already serves manifest-registered entries byte-faithfully; this TAC only adds entries and markdown files. The managed block is regenerated by `rcf doctor` from the fragment in guidance/harness-template.md; the two new rules append to that fragment, and the regeneration pass preserves rules the project authored outside the managed markers.

interfaces.name: rcf_define_intent
interfaces.description: Argument-free MCP prompt served from guidance/define-intent.md.

interfaces.name: rcf_define_intake
interfaces.description: Argument-free MCP prompt served from the intake prompt markdown.

interfaces.name: rcf_define_draft_shapes
interfaces.description: Argument-free MCP prompt served from guidance/define-draft-shapes.md: walks the agent through pre-populating [draft] core entities, TAC stubs and interfaces after L1 is green.

interfaces.name: rcf_discover_prototype
interfaces.description: Argument-free MCP prompt served from guidance/discover-prototype.md: walks the agent through recording a prototype in DISCOVERY as evidence (classification, brief statements with prototype: source spans, the burn statement, the salvage-by-re-derivation path).

interfaces.name: rcf://docs/discovery-prototypes
interfaces.description: Resource URI backed by guidance/discovery-prototypes.md: the doctrine and the ledger conventions for prototypes in DISCOVERY (ADR-4132).

interfaces.name: rcf_define_litmus
interfaces.description: Argument-free MCP prompt served from guidance/define-litmus.md: walks the harness through spawning n fresh-context readers at the current tree hash and landing their readings as probe-ledger entries whose `finding` begins `litmus:<reader>:` and whose text includes the hash (0.30.0 PR 7).

notes: This TAC was authored by PR 2 after the guidance slice did not land on origin/main under its reserved id ADR-4128 / TAC-4128; the shift is recorded in the PR 2 report. Later DEFINE PRs may expand it with further prompts and managed rules.
